contract: Optional single YouTube video on a public fundraising campaign, selected first alongside photos; load only after interaction, retain a direct watch link, and preserve the existing gallery without video. Source contracts and states in docs/Features/Campaign video.md.

accessibility.evidence: axe-core reported zero tested WCAG A/AA violations on the host UI at 1440, 768, 390 and 320px. Labelled media controls use aria-pressed. Loading transfers focus to the titled iframe. YouTube third-party controls are outside this host audit.

responsive.evidence: No horizontal document overflow at target widths and 320px; iframe area remains at least 200x200px. Desktop 782x440, tablet 697x392, mobile 335x285, 320px viewport 265x285.

loading.evidence: The player has a reserved responsive area; explicit load mounts the iframe without resizing the media panel.

empty.evidence: Video-only campaign uses the branded introduction without a photo; photo-only campaign keeps existing gallery.

error.evidence: A direct Watch on YouTube link stays visible independently of iframe load or playback state. The app does not claim to detect every third-party embed error.

partial.evidence: Photos and video remain independently selectable; lack of a cover does not hide the video.

success.evidence: The official demo player loaded and playback advanced after pressing its Play video button.

permission.evidence: API integration tests verify 401 without auth, 404 for another owner and 409 during review.

renderedEvidence.observation: Campaign cover used as local poster with explicit load control and photo switch.
Media panel and controls reflow on tablet.
Mobile video panel fits without overflow and keeps donation action visible.

verification: Monorepo lint, typecheck and builds passed
No YouTube requests or iframe before load click
Embed uses youtube-nocookie.com and no autoplay parameter
Official YouTube demo played: paused=false, readyState=4, currentTime>0
Photo-only and video-only campaigns render correct controls
limits: No creator dashboard editor exists yet; video is supplied via the campaign create/update API.
Video availability and embedding permissions remain controlled by YouTube.
Automated host-page accessibility tests do not certify third-party player conformance.
